collection.title: Mazda Eunos 1989 to 1997 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mazda Eunos 1989 to 1997 model requires a 18" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
